It worked. But it taxes the VM, DB, and message bus alike and creates a ton of unnecessary observability data. A durable delay queue could be a better fit. Show HN: Quiet – exploring when an AI assistant should intervene
items.summary: I’m Ruggiero, a CS student working on a research project about humanComputer interaction and AI. I built QUIET because I’ve been thinking about a problem with current AI interfaces: they usually either wait for an explicit prompt, or try to take over a task. I wanted to explore a different relationship between humans and AI: an assistant that can understand when to stay out of the way, when to point something out, when to teach, and when to act. items.title: Show HN: Kyno – Direction as a first-class primitive for AI agents
items.summary: Hi folks, I've been lurking here for a while, and after almost two months of building, I finally dared to share what I've been working on. It's called Kyno (pronounced KAI-no).
